sources.terms_quote: In general, information presented on this web site, unless otherwise indicated, is considered in the public domain. It may be distributed or copied as permitted by law.
Persons requesting copies of public records maintained by the Commission must submit a written request to the Commission’s Open Records Officer.
Information collected and received through the Illinois Commerce Commission web site may become public record and therefore subject to disclosure under the Illinois Freedom of Information Act.

Although the content of PUCT web sites is available to the public, certain information on the PUCT web sites may be trademarked, service marked, or otherwise protected as the PUCT's intellectual property, and all PUCT content is protected by federal copyright laws.

rows.title: Decision 26-02-025, Decision Establishing a Standard Offer for Flexible Service Connections
rows.sentence: This decision directs Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E) and Southern California Edison Company (SCE) to establish a standard offer process within the Design and Engineering step of their energization process that establishes an optional Flexible Service Connection1 (FSC) agreement for customers affected by distribution capacity constraints.
rows.read: PG&E and SCE must offer an optional flexible connection agreement, letting customers facing distribution capacity limits use more power when grid conditions are safe, rather than waiting for an upgrade.
